title: AI companies destroy physical books — let’s scan rare books before it’s too late
summary: 文章警告AI公司为训练模型而大规模扫描实体书，导致稀有书籍被物理销毁，呼吁在彻底消失前进行抢救性扫描。
highlights: AI companies are destroying physical books in the process of scanning them for training data.
Rare books are being lost forever, and we need to act before it's too late.
The article urges immediate action to digitize rare books before they are destroyed.
